about: Scene plates for the pathway tracer and Predict the change (tool redesign 2026-11). Each scene is a registered figure (data/figures) and the places on it, in the figure's own pixels: where a step happens or a variable lives. Places were set by eye on a grid over the figure. hide lists printed labels to cover (true: all) and cover adds boxes, for process figures whose stage words or numbers would give the order away. Which steps and variables sit where: data/pathway-scenes.json and data/predict-scenes.json. Drawn by assets/tools/scene.js; checked by scripts/test/anp-scenes.test.mjs.
